Specialization.Name: Scientist (reSpecialized) 1.1
Specialization.Description: [H4]SCIENTIST (reSpecialized)[h4][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The scientist is the “creation-focused” Scholarly archetype that serves to role-fill as the “swiss army smartypants” that can do any number of important intelligence things in the party. Scientists know things and they make things.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ½ Using Knowledge for General and Social Utility ½ Using Int-Based Skills to Craft/Make Things/Improve Things[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Scientist ideally should be the best at making things, but not in a Grease-Monkey kind of way[BR] Knowing Things, a-la the Scholar[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Medicine[BR] Mechanics[BR] Computers[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Scholar[i](The closest as a 1 to 1. The Scientist cares heavily about knowing things, but doesn’t go deep as the scholar. It tries to leverage pure intelligence though).[BR] [I]Doctor[i](They both share medicine and both leverage knowledge socially, but that’s about it. The Medicine side of the Scholar is very understated).[BR] [I]Analyst[i](Very similar trees. They have socially-leaning Knowledge side that centers around utility, and the other half leans towards a different niche (computers). But while it’s a single niche for Analyst, it’s more like 3 niches for Scientist).[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Mordin Solus (Mass Effect 2)[BR] Praxideke Meng (The Expanse)[BR] Miranda Lawson (Mass Effect)[BR] [I]updated 12/11/2025[i]
